title: Optimal state detection without likelihood estimation
summary: We show that adaptive Bayesian estimation in fluorescence state detection reduces to a comparison of elapsed time with two arithmetic time sequences fixed by the bright and dark count rates and confidence parameters $ε_d$ and $ε_b$. No probabilities are computed in real time and the resulting implementation, which we term sequential deadline detection, is provably optimal in mean detection time.
